cohort: 48 HEV positive pregnant women in a tertiary care hospital in Delhi
finding: Maternal mortality was 25% (12/48) in HEV-positive pregnant women, occurring exclusively in the postnatal period, primarily due to hepatic encephalopathy.
mod_finding: Of the 38 women who delivered, 35 (72.9%) had a vaginal delivery (27 preterm, 8 term) and 3 (6.25%) had a caesarean section.
followup_time: Postnatal period (up to at least 1 week after delivery)
